tip_text: Reframe negative thoughts with one simple prompt technique
title: Reframe Negative Thoughts Instantly | AnchorWithin Tool Tips
description:

#MentalHealth #CognitiveReframing #AICompanion #Shorts
narration: Your brain lies to you dozens of times a day. It says things like 'I always fail' or 'nobody cares about my work.' These are called cognitive distortions, and therapists have been helping people reframe them for decades. Now you can do it yourself. Tell the AI Companion the negative thought that is stuck in your head. It identifies the distortion type. Catastrophizing. All-or-nothing thinking. Mind reading. Then it offers a reframed version that is more accurate and less painful. Not toxic positivity. Just truth. Instead of 'I always fail,' it becomes 'I failed at this specific thing, and I can learn from it.' Small shift. Massive difference.
